description: Group the 99 reviewed PF01557 entries by EC branch and quantify how far the hydrolase and hydratase branches sit from bll6422
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
PR="/agent/jobs/be6dde12-f424-4543-aa88-9103cb899c33/provenance/"
sw=pd.read_csv(PR+"sw_PF01557_vs_Q89GC3.csv")
tsv=pd.read_csv(PR+"swissprot_PF01557.tsv",sep="\t").rename(columns={"Entry":"acc"})
m=sw.merge(tsv,on="acc",how="left")
def branch(ec):
    if not isinstance(ec,str) or not ec.strip(): return "no EC assigned"
    e=ec.split(";")[0].strip()
    if e.startswith("3.7.1"): return "C-C hydrolase (EC 3.7.1.x)"
    if e.startswith("4.2.1"): return "hydratase (EC 4.2.1.x)"
    if e.startswith("4.1.1"): return "decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.x)"
    return "other EC"
m["branch"]=m["EC number"].apply(branch)
m["experimental"]=m["Catalytic activity"].fillna("").str.contains("ECO:0000269")
summ=m.groupby("branch").agg(n=("acc","size"),n_experimental=("experimental","sum"),
      best_SW=("sw_score","max"),median_SW=("sw_score","median"),
      max_aln_cols=("aln_len","max"),median_aln_cols=("aln_len","median")).sort_values("best_SW",ascending=False)
print(summ.to_string())
print("\nTop 3 per branch:")
for b,g in m.groupby("branch"):
    g=g.sort_values("sw_score",ascending=False).head(3)
    print(" ",b)
    for _,r in g.iterrows():
        print("    %s %-14s SW %3d  %4.1f%% over %3d cols  len %3d  exp=%s  %s"%(
            r["acc"],str(r["Entry Name"])[:14],r["sw_score"],r["pct_id"],r["aln_len"],r["Length"],r["experimental"],str(r["EC number"])[:12]))
m.to_csv(PR+"table_PF01557_branch_summary_rows.csv",index=False)
summ.to_csv(PR+"table_PF01557_branch_summary.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,6))
colmap={"C-C hydrolase (EC 3.7.1.x)":"#1565c0","hydratase (EC 4.2.1.x)":"#c62828",
        "decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.x)":"#ef6c00","other EC":"#6a1b9a","no EC assigned":"#9e9e9e"}
for b,g in m.groupby("branch"):
    ax.scatter(g["aln_len"],g["sw_score"],s=np.where(g["experimental"],78,30),
               c=colmap[b],alpha=0.85,edgecolor="k",linewidth=np.where(g["experimental"],0.8,0.2),label=b)
top=m.sort_values("sw_score",ascending=False).iloc[0]
ax.annotate("Q1NEI7 LRA6, EC 3.7.1.26\nSW %d, %.1f%% over %d columns\n(PDB 8GSR, Mg$^{2+}$ + pyruvate)"%(top["sw_score"],top["pct_id"],top["aln_len"]),
            xy=(top["aln_len"],top["sw_score"]),xytext=(190,132),fontsize=8.5,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.9),bbox=dict(fc="#e3f2fd",ec="#1565c0",lw=0.8))
hyd=m[m["branch"]=="hydratase (EC 4.2.1.x)"]
ax.annotate("every characterised hydratase:\nSW %d-%d over %d-%d columns"%(hyd["sw_score"].min(),hyd["sw_score"].max(),hyd["aln_len"].min(),hyd["aln_len"].max()),
            xy=(hyd["aln_len"].max(),hyd["sw_score"].max()),xytext=(60,95),fontsize=8.5,color="#c62828",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.9,color="#c62828"),bbox=dict(fc="#fff3f3",ec="#c62828",lw=0.8))
ax.set_xlabel("aligned columns in the Smith-Waterman local alignment with bll6422")
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score (BLOSUM62, gap 11/1)")
ax.set_title("All 99 reviewed Swiss-Prot PF01557 entries scored against bll6422 (Q89GC3, 344 aa)\nlarge symbols: catalytic activity with experimental evidence (ECO:0000269)",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right");ax.grid(alpha=0.3);ax.set_axisbelow(True)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
